doc: Q308, the owner's third test: against other 3-D models. Measured over each model's own geometry catalogue, mesh nodes only.
method: Z-Anatomy: the 3,572 Blender OBJECT names of the pin. HRA/CCF: only nodes the manifest marks `author_node_type == mesh`, with their triangle count and bounding size. The other four models carry the measurement the round that surveyed them recorded, cited, and were not re-downloaded -- the disk has 0.66 GB free.
false_positives_of_the_first_pass: `antebrachial` without `lateral` matched the MEDIAL antebrachial cutaneous nerve, which does ship
`nail bed` / `digital pulp` matched this project's OWN cited_but_not_shipped rows in data/derived/Q306_search_*.json, read back as if they were a catalogue
`labi` matched the inferior LABIAL artery and veins -- of the lip, not the vulva

BodyParts3D v4.0 (CC BY 4.0).note: Q302 catalogued its 1,524 parts and found no peripheral nerve branch, no nail structure and a male `perineum` measured at 368 faces / 11.5 x 21.8 x 21.3 mm -- an area marker. Its free OBJ set is ~99 % decimated, so it is a SHAPE REFERENCE and not a source to ship. Not re-downloaded this round; this row is Q302's measurement, cited.

Chinese Visible Human (Wu 2015).note: colour cryosection segmentation; supplies this project's perineal muscles and perineal body. Holds none of these ten structures.

SPL / Open Anatomy (3D Slicer licence).note: Q296 surveyed all seven atlases: none contains a pelvis, pelvic floor or perineum, and none contains any of these ten. The inner-ear meshes are what this project imports.

SPARC 692.note: human sciatic nerve CALIBRE at defined levels only; the samples were excised and laid straight (85.1 mm arc), so there is no course in the body at all.

licence_blocked: Zygote and BioDigital were NOT consulted and nothing from them was used: Zygote is paid and proprietary, and Q302 additionally found its Reproductive and Nervous sets sculpted from atlases; BioDigital is a hosted viewer/API that delivers no mesh. Stated rather than omitted.

headline.finding: HRA / CCF united-female and united-male v1.10 hold the ANTEROLATERAL LIGAMENT OF THE KNEE as a real CLOSED mesh, on the SAME two Visible Human donors as this project's Imaging pages, under CC BY 4.0: VH_F left and right, 1,680 triangles, 9.0 x 56.9 x 14.2 mm; VH_M left and right, 790 triangles, 12.6 x 54.0 x 21.7 mm. UBERON:0014899.
headline.why_nobody_found_it_before: the ALL only became a recorded absence in Q306, and Q296 / Q302 surveyed HRA before that, against a different gap list. This is a new check, not a contradiction of theirs.
headline.consequence: the rule-based ALL this round ships SHOULD be replaced by that real mesh, at least on the two Imaging pages whose skeletons are those donors. That is an import round of its own: the GLBs are deliberately kept outside the repository (1.21 GB for the set) and the disk has 0.66 GB free, so it is brought to the owner as a decision rather than half-done here.
headline.caveat: HRA's 56.9 / 54.0 mm is a BOUNDING-BOX extent, not a centreline length, so it is an upper bound on the ligament's length and not directly our measured length.

anterolateral ligament of the knee: HRA / CCF (united female+male v1.10, CC BY 4.0, mesh nodes only)

conclusion.what_this_means: For the three families no reachable model holds, there is no other model's mesh to compare the SHAPE against, and that is precisely why they were built from cited literature on each page's own bones rather than imported. For the fourth -- the ALL -- a real mesh DOES exist and the honest conclusion is that ours should give way to it.
